title: What the vetoes know: the MSSI tagging efficiency, its wall/RFR split, and the information in the event's silence in Skin and OD
question: What prompt-veto tagging efficiency do LZ's own counts imply for wall vs RFR MSSI, what is it for the event's specific 12+77 keV wall (and 12+204 keV RFR) decomposition, what likelihood ratio does the absence of any Skin/OD signal carry beyond LZ's 94% factor, and is the delayed-sample 55 vs 50.4 informative?
headline_result: For the 12+77 keV wall-MSSI decomposition the outgoing gamma is Skin/OD-tagged with 97.7% (96.0-99.5%) efficiency vs the 94.9% LZ applies, so the event's veto silence penalises wall MSSI by a further 0.46 (0.10-0.79), raising P004's k_required 619 -> 1350 (530-9000) and P033's 6.4e4 -> 1.4e5; the wall efficiency is tested by data only to >0.32; the delayed excess is 0.6 sigma
key_numbers: paper-implied eps: MSSI 0.940 (=lambda_MSSI), det. ERs 0.880 (=lambda_PG); table wall 0.949, RFR 0.999, 214Pb HE-SB RFR 0.195; table prompt 0.19 vs S1 0.077 (x2.5); wall sidebands 0/2 -> eps>0.32 (90%); HE-SB RFR 3/21=0.143 (0.066-0.262) p=0.78; topology untagged 2.33+-0.13% (A), 0.99+-0.64% (B), range 0.52-3.97%; skin 4/8 cm 3.5/1.4%; OD thr 20-200 keV 2.1-3.8%; RFR topology 99% tagged (27-49% if extra RFR light allowed); LR vs DM: wall 0.060->0.023 (0.005-0.040), RFR 0.008, det-ER/neutron 0.12; delayed P(N>=55)=0.28 (0.57 sigma), random prediction 50.35, chi2 photons need 6.6-490 clean events; sub-threshold search: 19% of silent histories, random 0.9-3.6e-3, LR 50-210
model_or_mechanism: efficiencies from the supplement MSSI table and Tables I/S1/S2 with Clopper-Pearson checks; Klein-Nishina ray-march photon MC of the outgoing gamma in a cylindrical LZ model (shell, PTFE, Skin, Ti, water, GdLS, PMT arrays) with strict S1 budget; veto-silence likelihood ratios; Poisson/Gaussian p-value for the delayed sample
stance: supports DM interpretation (weakly, a further factor ~2 against wall MSSI only)
confidence: medium: paper-derived efficiencies exact; topology MC rests on recalled Skin/OD geometry and light yields (range 0.5-4%)
